Electrical Engineer (Oil and Gas) Job at Groupe Aldelia Limited




        
    

        
        Groupe Aldelia Limited (Aldelia Nigeria) is a leading international Human Resources and recruitment consultancy firm. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position:  Electrical Engineer (Oil and Gas)

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Electrical  Engineer with at least 12 years of experience in designing electrical systems for offshore and onshore oil & gas facilities.
	The successful candidate will support electrical design, load verification, cable sizing, hazardous area compliance, electrical tie-ins, and safety studies while ensuring compliance with industry standards and project requirements.


Key Responsibilities
Electrical Engineering:


	Design and review electrical systems for offshore and onshore oil & gas facilities.
	Verify electrical equipment load lists and perform cable sizing.
	Review electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, and design documents.
	Support FEED, Detailed Engineering, construction, and commissioning activities.
	Provide technical support for electrical tie-ins and installations.


Safety & Compliance:


	Participate in SAFOP and other electrical safety studies.
	Apply Hazardous Area Classification requirements and specify suitable electrical equipment for hazardous zones.
	Ensure compliance with company standards, IEC/IEEE codes, and regulatory requirements.


Project Support:


	Review vendor documents and contractor deliverables.
	Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
	Support troubleshooting, commissioning, and facility modifications.


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.


Experience:


	Minimum of 12 years of experience in Electrical Engineering within the Oil & Gas industry.
	Proven experience in offshore and onshore facility design.
	Experience with electrical tie-ins, cable sizing, and hazardous area classification.


Technical Competencies:


	Electrical System Design
	Electrical Load List Verification
	Cable Sizing
	Electrical Tie-ins
	SAFOP Studies
	Hazardous Area Classification
	Electrical Equipment Selection
	FEED & Detailed Engineering
	Commissioning & Start-up
	IEC/IEEE Standards.


Behavioural Competencies:


	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication and teamwork.
	High attention to detail.
	Strong planning and organizational skills.


Preferred Certifications:


	COREN registration or equivalent.
	CompEx or other Hazardous Area certification (preferred).
	Relevant HSE certification.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the job title as the subject of the email.

Maintenance Engineer Job at Jobvet Services




        
    

        
        Jobvet Services - Our client, a plastic sack manufacturing  organization, is  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Maintenance Engineer 

Job Location: Yola, Adamawa
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The Maintenance Engineer will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of machinery, contributing to production efficiency and equipment reliability.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Perform regular maintenance and inspections on production equipment.
	Solve mechanical issues to minimize downtime.
	Collaborate with production staff to enhance equipment performance.
	Maintain records of maintenance activities and repairs.
	Ensure compliance with safety standards during maintenance operations.


Requirements


	Proven experience in maintenance within manufacturing environments.
	Specialized knowledge in extrusion, looms, and circular weaving machines.
	Ability to troubleshoot and resolve machinery issues effectively.
	Strong understanding of safety protocols and maintenance procedures.
	Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 per month.
